earlier_attempts.result: Initial collector incorrectly required acknowledgements for every intent. Controller death can leave one pending tail intent. The final collector requires it to belong to that case, follow the verified prefix and remain absent from the public cursor; it does not infer object or spool availability.

The second run reused the first run retained spool destination and rename rejected DirectoryNotEmpty. A fresh explicit private spool and object-cache configuration was used for the final run; no prior evidence was deleted.
Shell environment was not inherited by strict test actions. Reran with the documented three explicit --test_env values.

Flood retained both complete prefixes but final report was rejected. Two fixes: a pending renewal must be consumed before a normal final report; a deterministic regression fails without this guard. The repeated flood failure was traced to reaper liveness after process exit, while the large report was still buffered. Receiving now continues only after pinned cgroup and all runtime pidfds prove termination, within the old deadline and with IO closed. Two traced focused runs failed before that change; all seven focused cases passed after it. Full real suite rerun.

Private temporary spool permissions corrected to 0700; full workspace passed.
Boxed control variants and fixed test raw shell string literals; final all-target Clippy and builds passed.
